manual: Build with community-apps/monologue/install.sh (CMake). Stock Devuan Excalibur Qt 6.8 satisfies upstream's Qt ≥ 6.8 requirement.
Camera capture uses Qt Multimedia's FFmpeg backend against V4L2 (/dev/video*). A PulseAudio-compatible server (PulseAudio or pipewire-pulse) supplies the microphone.
The save dialog needs the GTK xdg-desktop-portal backend, which install.sh pulls in.
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset, so corners stay square on i3.
